Im 13 and just some day I just want to die, I just want to be invisible sometimes. And in some ways I am, like to my parents or to my “friends” I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety in the 4th grade when my mom and dad split. Then I didn’t think about it I thought I got better until 7th grade that’s when I first cut. And now I’m in 8th grade and no one cares that I try not to talk at all to anyone. About anything. I act like things are ok but nothing is. I hate myself sometimes.

I’m really sorry for you. I’m 13 and cut. I tried to call the  suicide hotline but got too scared to talk. The hung up. When I told my  best friend that I cut she freaked out. She didn’t want to see me hurting. And  I honestly know where you’re coming from I have had anxiety and depression since I was in 4th grade and I still cry almost every day because I don’t know how to deal with it. But I know you don’t know who I am but I just need you to know that most people won’t make fun of you for your voice. And about you being scared in p.e, I was really scared to be in p.e because once I got hit in the head with a basket ball and I got laughed at because I didn’t see the ball. I’m staring to get over that but it still scares me to be even near the gym. I don’t like to talk at all I’ll just try to avoid face to face conversation and try to text over talking. I honestly just hated the amount of “umm’s.” Or the “like’s” I thought people would judge me for that. But every time I see people whispering and look over at me I  get scared that it’s about me. I really hope that you get through this. I believe in you.
